user.title: RV Door Lock

create_pin.name: Create PIN

create_temporary_pin.name: Create temporary PIN
create_temporary_pin.description: Store a PIN valid only between start and end (optionally on certain weekdays/hours or for a number of uses).

delete_pin.name: Delete PIN

delete_fingerprint.description: Remove a fingerprint enrolled from HA.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name used when it was enrolled

list_credentials.name: List credentials
list_credentials.description: PINs and fingerprints created from HA.

forget_credential.name: Forget credential
forget_credential.description: Drop a stored PIN or fingerprint record without talking to the lock (every record when no name is given).
